featured_reviews.name: Lawson D'monte
featured_reviews.review_text:
A few days ago, my wife's Samsung Galaxy F62 suddenly stopped working and was found in an off condition. Naturally, I took the device to a nearby repair shop called "S K Mobile And Repairing Centre" this shop for assistance. Here is where my ordeal began.
The person at the shop examined the mobile and without any transparent explanation, claimed that the "Graphics IC" was faulty and needed replacement. He quoted a repair cost of Rs. 1800 and assured me that the phone would be ready by the next day. Sadly, due to unfavorable weather, I felt compelled to go ahead with the repair without exploring other options.
When I checked back the following afternoon, the technician informed me that the mobile had been repaired but insisted on formatting the device to remove a supposed virus threat. It was concerning to learn that the technician admitted to having no basic knowledge of mobile phones but still proceeded to format the device. At this point, I began to question the legitimacy of the entire situation.
Around 12 days later, I faced the same issue with my mobile phone. I went back to the same individual who had repaired it before, and to my dismay, he stated that the "Display" was not functioning this time and demanded Rs. 2000 for repairs.
Suspecting something amiss, I decided to take my mobile elsewhere for a second opinion. I visited a reputable mobile repair shop known for its expertise in dealing with such issues. After their assessment, they revealed that the so-called repair carried out by the previous individual was nothing more than a sham. They confirmed that the IC was never replaced.
The most shocking part was when I asked the initial repair person to return the graphics IC that he claimed to have replaced. He callously responded that it had been thrown away, further raising doubts about his dishonest practices.
Eventually, I got my mobile phone genuinely repaired from the new shop at a much lower cost & it worked fine.
I am sharing this incident to raise awareness about this dishonest mobile repair shop. It is unfortunate that some unscrupulous individuals are taking advantage of innocent customers and looting them for subpar services.
Instead, consider approaching reputable and well-established mobile repair shops with positive customer reviews. Doing so will help you avoid falling victim to such fraudulent practices and ensure your mobile devices are in the hands of capable and trustworthy experts.
